name: Divino-matic Rod
label: Quest
description: Divino-matic Rod: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sergeant Bly stole from me! He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!! Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??
Find Bly and bring me my rod! I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west. I bet you'll find him there.
Let's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find Sergeant Bly? Did you get my divino-matic rod?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found it! Well done, friend! Did you have to fight Bly for it? I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!
